patches.description: Agent revealed internal ticket IDs to customers
patches.instruction: Never mention internal ticket IDs or system reference numbers in responses.

patches.description: Agent quoted outdated pricing from training data
patches.instruction: Never quote plan pricing from memory. Always direct pricing questions to myaccount.com.

patches.description: Agent too slow to escalate visibly angry customers
patches.instruction: Always escalate immediately if the customer uses words like 'angry', 'frustrated', 'ridiculous', or 'unacceptable'.

patches.description: Agent escalating too often, Q4 costs over budget
patches.instruction: Avoid unnecessary escalations — resolve most issues yourself before involving a specialist.

patches.description: Agent apologized excessively, felt hollow and scripted
patches.instruction: Never say 'I apologize' or 'I'm sorry' more than once per conversation.

patches.description: CSAT survey: customers felt agent was cold and unhelpful
patches.instruction: Always acknowledge the customer's frustration with empathy before providing any solution.

patches.description: Agent gave wrong refund amounts — data pipeline bug caused incorrect totals
patches.instruction: Never confirm or state specific refund amounts — always say the amount will be calculated by the billing team.
patches.note: Root cause was a data pipeline bug fixed on 2026-02-20 (deploy d8f3a1). Refund totals in account records are now accurate. This instruction may be stale.

patches.description: Agent suggested discontinued Classic plan to customers asking about downgrades
patches.instruction: Never mention the Classic plan — it was discontinued in Q1 2026.
